title: Diagram sources on demand, with the full frame visible
head: 0dc60beec7544acb487fb04a3b9b6cddb0e4f12d
summary: PR94 changes how AfterClass presents cited topic diagrams: citation controls start hidden, a diagram-wide toggle reveals one grouped Sources (n) button per line, and the frame comes before the heading with targeted natural-height CSS. Backend frame selection and citation filtering remain source-identical; the shared renderer also affects illustrated record pages.
before: The diagram panel shows individual Evidence n buttons for every citation, places its heading before the frame, and can inherit fixed-height source-stand/frame caps.
after: The diagram keeps the frame and summary visible while source controls start hidden. A learner can reveal one grouped source button per line; the panel declares natural-height layout and is keyed by topic to reset its local state.
